answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to solve a complex computational cipher to validate blocks. Each node must commit resources equivalent to a marble-sized fraction of global energy, ensuring that identity creation is not a velvet glove operation but a high-cost capital expenditure. By tethering participation to verifiable physical output, the network forces an attacker to incur prohibitive operational costs, effectively nullifying the incentive for mass identity forgery.
